map.输入系统扭矩与温度/磨损补偿率，计算实际所需补偿扭矩: Enter system torque with temperature/wear compensation rates to compute the actual required compensation torque.
map.扭矩补偿：基于系统扭矩、温度补偿率、磨损补偿率与动载荷系数，对输出扭矩进行温度/: Torque compensation: based on system torque, temperature-compensation rate, wear-compensation rate and dynamic-load factor, apply temperature/wear/dynamic corrections to the output torque, for precision transmission torque calibration.
map.💡 补偿扭矩=T×(1+温度补偿%+磨损补偿%)×动载荷系数×工况系数: Formula: compensation torque=T times (1+temp%+wear%) times dynamic factor times condition factor.
map.温度补偿考虑热膨胀对配合间隙的影响，高温取 5%-15%: Temperature compensation considers thermal expansion on fit clearance; high temp 5%-15%.
map.磨损补偿考虑长期运行后间隙增大，一般取 5%-20%: Wear compensation considers increased clearance after long running; generally 5%-20%.
map.动载荷系数考虑启动/制动冲击，通常 1.1-1.5: Dynamic load factor considers start/stop shock; usually 1.1-1.5.
map.📚 深度解析：扭矩补偿计算（温度、磨损与动载叠加）: In-depth: Torque compensation calculation (temperature, wear and dynamic-load superposition)
map.传动裕量设计：在原扭矩上叠加温度与磨损补偿，确定设计扭矩: Transmission margin design: add temperature and wear compensation on the original torque to set the design torque.
map.变工况评估：按动载系数与工况系数放大，核算总补偿率: Variable-condition assessment: amplify by dynamic and condition factors, check total compensation rate.
map.改造复核：磨损后重新核算所需扭矩，判断是否需加大驱动: Retrofit check: after wear, re-check the required torque to judge whether to enlarge the drive.
map.算法：温度补偿 = 系统扭矩×温度补偿率%；磨损补偿 = 系统扭矩×磨损补偿率%: Algorithm: temperature compensation = system torque times temp%; wear compensation = system torque times wear%; base compensation = system torque + temp + wear; compensated torque = base times dynamic factor times condition factor; total compensation rate = (compensated/system - 1) times 100%. Assessment: total >50% large, recheck design advised; >30% moderate, periodic inspection; else normal.
map.例：系统扭矩 500N·m、温度补偿 5%、磨损补偿 10%、动载 1.2、工况: Example: system torque 500 N m, temp 5%, wear 10%, dynamic 1.2, condition 1.1 -> temp 25.0 N m, wear 50.0 N m, base 575.0 N m, compensated 759.0 N m, total +51.8%, hint: large compensation, recheck design. If changed to temp 2%, wear 3%, dynamic 1.1, condition 1.0 -> compensation 10.0+15.0, base 525.0, compensated 577.5 N m, total +15.5%, normal. If wear alone raised to 30% (rest same) -> base 675.0, compensated 891.0 N m, total +78.2%.
map.温度和磨损为什么要按: Why compensate for temperature and wear by
map.本工具把它们建模为对额定扭矩的等比增量：温度升高带来材料膨胀与配合间隙变化，使摩: This tool models them as a proportional increment on rated torque: temperature rise brings material expansion and fit-clearance change, raising friction resistance; wear enlarges clearance and lowers transmission efficiency, also needing more drive torque. Both are empirical ratios; without measured data take 2% to 10% by condition, upper bound for harsh conditions.
map.总补偿率超过 50% 一定不合理吗？: Is total compensation over 50% necessarily unreasonable?
map.不一定，但需复核。首例中动载 1.2 与工况 1.1 本身就带来 32% 放大，: Not necessarily, but recheck. In the first example dynamic 1.2 and condition 1.1 already give 32% amplification, plus 15% temp/wear breaks 50%. If the condition is genuinely harsh (frequent start/stop, dust, high temp), the value is reasonable; otherwise check whether factors are too conservative, causing oversized motor and transmission and wasted cost.
map.扭矩补偿计算器根据系统额定扭矩，考虑温度膨胀补偿、磨损间隙补偿和动载荷系数，计算: The torque compensation calculator, from the system rated torque, considering temperature-expansion compensation, wear-clearance compensation and dynamic-load factor, computes the actual required compensation torque, for transmission-system design and torque-margin assessment.
